Intro: I have smelled these walls before. Thy paint, thy blood, thine ichor. *hic*
Under His breath lies the bleach in this world's ceiling, the bitter fumes that once covered the skies in red and yellow, that bright liquor. *hic*
What we do for the spirit's love is yet formidified, as this room has yet been covered in formaldehyde. Have we truly adapted to this brave new world?
I DID! It was my own volition that let me here, not the drink. I'll show it. Create thine great [DISH], apron! I can choose, and so I will choose!
Success: Oooh? Hmm. Coarse, but not dry. Stingy, with a hint of foul air. Oh what… taste. No. I cannot describe this with words. A thorough analysis is needed!
Fail: Oooh? AUGH! Thy nostrils experience the war once more! It is foul. It is… sour. Was this meal impossible before the War? A dour thought. Interesting.
Reject: Y- you see me with the eyes of an animal. You desire to hunt, but I am no prey. I am VICIOUS! Brought your kind to near extinction. I can do so again…
